reviews.text: Awesome place and so big! He cleaned up nicely and the staff were so nice and friendly to the dogs.
This was a wonderful  place to self wash my pug, I love the tubs & private rooms to blow dry. The staff is very thoughtful.
First time coming here and they took great care of my Benji! They are also really polite and friendly!

This place is really great! I've been once for full service grooming and Lauren did a fabulous job with my doodle. I went yesterday to use their self-service dog wash station since they give you the first wash free. Even though it was self-service, Tiffany was super helpful and showed me how everything worked and could not have been nicer (and I had lots of questions). Really excellent customer service.  I will definitely continue to utilize their services.

Lauren does such a great job with Theo every time. He is a very shy boy but she understands him and knows to take things slowly. His perfect haircut afterwards is just a bonus. That you Lauren and PetBar!

I love how clean the place it. They had towels which I had forgotten which was very helpful. It’s very spacious for my medium sized German shepherd Husky and I. I will say I did bring my own dog wash, I felt the dog wash there is very watered down and I like the see the bubbles on my dog but the condition made my baby feel super soft. They have a strong commercial blower which my dog didn’t like so they had a smaller blow dryer which she delt with. Cleaned my dogs ears for the first time and finished her off with some doggie perfume. I did leave a little mess but they were so kind about it all. I know some other places are probably cheaper but this place seems really nice and super close, probably will go again.
Always a fantastic experience at PetBar.  The dogs look beautiful after their baths, the staff is friendly, and the bathers and groomers are experienced and compassionate.

I took all three of my dogs to Pet Bar to be groomed, and we had such a great experience! They’re always a little nervous going to the groomer, so I especially appreciated being able to see them on the video camera when I came to pick them up. All three were snuggled together, sound asleep while the groomer worked on another dog. I loved knowing they were comfortable and relaxed instead of sitting in kennels.

I even got to watch as the groomer put their leashes on to bring them out to me, and all three were jumping around, loving on her. That told me everything I needed to know—they clearly felt safe and well cared for!

They came home incredibly soft, fluffy, and happy. Such a great experience for all three of them. We will definitely be back!

Love PetBar and the staff. Lauren does an amazing job on our 2 schnauzers! You can tell they love her which gives me peace of mind as well. We have been coming here for over a year and will continue to come see Lauren for a long time!
Amazing vibes, amazing staff (which almost feels odd to say because they seem to be more 'friend' than 'someone who works with dogs'), amazing results.

There are businesses that provide a service, and then there are businesses that become part of your family's story. PetBar Arcadia is the latter.

Our sweet Yogi was over 110 pounds, incredibly fluffy, and had severe anxiety—especially when it came to grooming. For the first four years of his life, finding a groomer was one of the most stressful parts of being his owner. We had groomers tell us they couldn't work with him because they didn't know how to handle his fear. Every grooming appointment filled me with anxiety because I never knew how it would go.

Everything changed when we found PetBar after moving to the area in 2024.

From our very first visit with Yogi and our older dog, Smokey, I knew we had finally found the right place. Every single person on their team treated Yogi with so much patience, compassion, and understanding. They never saw him as a "difficult dog." They saw him for exactly who he was—a gentle giant who was simply scared. They would even block off extra time in their schedule so he could decompress, move at his own pace, and never feel rushed or overwhelmed. That level of care is something I'll never forget.

When Smokey passed away last year, the team was incredibly kind and compassionate. Then this year, as Yogi began experiencing serious health issues, they graciously worked with us to pause our membership while he was too sick to be groomed. About two weeks before he passed away, he was finally feeling well enough for one last bath and brush after nearly two months without one. They treated him so gently and with so much love, and he walked out looking—and I truly believe feeling—like a million bucks. I will always be grateful that one of his final experiences was being cared for by people who loved him so well.

After Yogi passed away, I called to cancel our membership. The very next day, one of the owners personally reached out with the sweetest text message and a video filled with photos and clips of both Yogi and Smokey from their visits over the years. It was one of the most thoughtful, meaningful gifts we could have received during such a heartbreaking time, and it is something our family will treasure forever.

PetBar never treated us like customers. They treated Yogi and Smokey like family, and they treated us the same way. Their kindness, patience, and genuine love for animals go so far beyond grooming. I can never thank them enough for the care they gave our boys, especially in Yogi's final chapter.

When the day comes that we're ready to welcome another dog into our family, there isn't a single place we'll consider other than PetBar Arcadia.

Took my rescue, Nico, here for the first time as our previous groomer had moved earlier this spring and he was long overdue! Everyone was so friendly and Haily was amazing! He looks so handsome.

We’ll be booking again!

We just took two of our dogs over to Petbar Boutique Arcadia for the first time. We have a German Shepherd/Malinois mix who's 70lbs and almost 2 years old, and a 10month old Malinois who's about 65lb.

The GSD/Mal mix received a full service wash with a de-shed treatment, and we did the self-wash for our 10month Mal.

The GSD has never been to a groomer before, and the Petbar team was so great in making sure she felt safe. She was a little unsure about getting into the wash tub, and their crew member hoisted her up with ease. When it came to drying our pup, they even put a little ear cover on her so she felt comfortable, because the dryers are pretty loud.

Self wash was also great for our 10month Mal. He did awesome, and the dryer was a little scary so we asked for one of the ear covers for him and that helped a lot.

Both dogs are now so incredibly soft, and we no longer find tumbleweeds of fluff from our GSD/Mal mix every morning, despite daily vacuuming.

We'll definitely be coming back for future services. Great place, and great crew!
Polite professional courteous efficient
Very kind and helpful team! So much better for my Georgie Girl! No mess cleanly up tub, towels and brushes! Loved it!

PetBar is my go to place. My pups love Hailey and I appreciate her hard work and dedication to my dogs. She treats them like her own. They always look terrific when I pick them up. Highly recommend PetBar and Hailey 🙂
Kat is an excellent groomer....
They did a good job. And we're very kind and gentle with my dog.
I loved my self wash experience. They provided everything needed with multiple shampoo options, scrubbers, and dryers. The staff was super friendly as well. Will definitely bring my pup here again!

My experience from start to finish was fabulous! We’ve been anxiously awaiting the opening of Petbar and they delivered. I called to schedule and appointment and much to my surprise the owner answered the phone and was able to get me scheduled for a cut/wash fairly quickly. He was also super sweet and professional during the process which made me feel good about taking my pup there. We got our dog groomed yesterday by Ashley and everything was AWESOME!! Ashley was great with Arya from the start and we are absolutely in love with the cut. Our dog is happy and looks adorable. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Do yourself a favor and go!
The Petbar was so great! Excellent staff, especially Brenna at the front desk, and all the supplies made our dog look great at the end.
Great experience bringing a sensitive, never been bathed cat! They were gentle, comforting and made me feel great about the service!

I scheduled an appointment at 1:30. I paid $40 up front. I called to say that I would be 12 mins late. The person that answered the phone said she needed to check. She came back to the phone and said she could not accept my dog. I asked if I could at least get a bath and brush which cuts a lot of time out and he can get a full groom another time. She said no! I asked if I could get my money back or reschedule and was told, no!
I am very upset because I believe you she always try to accommodate your customers within reason. I have noticed the response. What you have stated in your response is not true. I requested for the owner to call me in regards to the way that I was treated. This is not the first time that I have been treated disrespected at this business and made to feel like I am not welcomed. I would have appreciated a call and for this to be handled in a professional and respectful manner. Instead my money was taken and there was no call.

My Baby looks FABULOUS. When I picked him up he was not scared or afraid of the staff, like he had been in the past at other places I’d taken him. And he was done so quickly, which was so good because he is very scared of loud noises and being away from home. I want to thank you so much for the wonderful care of my baby…I appreciate more than you could ever know.

I did a walk-in to get my dog a nail trim and rounding. Service was friendly, price was good, and I was in and out of there in five minutes. Establishment was also clean, I would go back for other services in the future.

The Petbar Boutique at Arcadia is amazing. My puppy got her first self wash on the house and all the supplies necessary were all provided. She smells and looks very clean. Definitely worth getting the membership. Thank you!
Love this place today was my first time going here and the environment and people are very nice and helpful my dog was fresh and clean

I took my dog to the pet bar boutique. And it was the best experience I could ever ask for. He’s a rescue and was very nervous going in. And walked out with his tail, wagging, and a big smile on his face. They were very patient with him and worked very well with him. Not to mention, the haircut looked so good. Shout out to Kat She really made his experience a great one. Can’t wait to take him in again. Thank you so much for treating my little prince like Royalty❤️
Outstanding & polite staff. Super easy to come get services done as everything needed was provided!

I needed a last-minute appointment and they were able to accommodate! Our girl doesn’t love to be groomed and past places have made her look silly, so we’ve been doing it ourselves lately, but petbar was so accommodating, communicative and did a great job! Very happy.
Highly recommend petbar for grooming. Their staff is extremely friendly and knowledgeable and my pup looks great!!

The place is clean. The people are very friendly & the service Is very good. My dog was happy with the service and so was i
. Thank you
Great customer services and very clean facility
Brant and his team took excellent care of my dog. She is always anxious when getting cleaned but they calmed her down and she was very happy by the end. Highly recommended!

How do you review a place that provides a great service for your dog and then charges nothing! This wonderful organization offers are 100% free first self bath, I brought my great Pyrenees and I was there over for two hours, they helped me over and over again and never asked for anything! I went there completely nervous, and I walked away with an absolutely beautiful and clean Dog! And if I had paid, it only would’ve been $25, I never knew I could save this much money and actually washing your own dogs. Get you really close to your dog in a way that you never did before. I couldn’t recommend this place enough.

I took two of my dogs here yesterday for the first time; my shih-poo for a full grooming and my frenchie for just a bath. I explained to the two groomers that my frenchie gets severe separation anxiety and I would appreciate if he could be near my shih-poo or at least have my shih-poo in sight for him. They assured me that wouldn't be an issue and they would keep them together throughout the services.

When I went back to pick them up, the first sound I hear is a dog  crying his little heart out. When we asked if that was our frenchie, the woman laughed and nodded.. she then went on to say "a few others walked in and asked if he was okay but i told them it was just frenchie noises"... Uh? "frenchie noises"?? No. My dog was crying due to being completely separated from everyone, for who knows how long. Had I been told my dogs couldn't be kept near each other, I would've happily picked him up as soon as his service was done.

Aside from that, when we finally got him back, his nose was cut and bleeding. They kept blaming it on him doing it to himself but I don't understand how that's possible. Honestly a 0/5 star experience for my frenchie.

I would like to give Danielle a shoutout though. She groomed my shih-poo and he looked amazing. The only reason I gave even 3 stars is solely for her. She listened to exactly what I wanted and he came out looking perfect.

Everyone is always so friendly and inviting. I have not met a single person here that I didn’t like. My dogs always come looking and smelling absolutely fabulous! I went to a different “franchise” groomer before coming here and let’s just say I was not given warm and fuzzy feelings so I was absolutely thrilled when I found petbar Arcadia and everyone was so wonderful. I cannot say enough nice things about them. I also won a free membership for a year which was pretty awesome too.

Best self serve dog wash. My first time but I was impressed with the staff, the cleanliness, and the care of the dogs they were caring for.
I'm picky for my fur babies. This was nice!!

I found them online and had great reviews. I took a shot and booked online an appt for my 2 girls. On day of the appt I was greeted and introduced to the groomer. She went over how I like them groomed and I felt comfortable right away. They were their for about 2 hrs and when I picked them up they looked amazing. I will definitely be a back for all my girls grooming needs.

Took my handsome 5 month old in yesterday to get his first full service grooming done. My dog Maverick is a very sensitive and dramatic baby when it comes to him getting his nails trimmed. Not only were these groomers fast, but they genuinely put love and care into the animals, and my little guy left happy. Will definitely be back!

What a great experience! I have two larger dogs and went twice in one day because it was that easy! The staff was so nice and friendly. Facility and amenities were so clean. Washing dogs can be stressful, especially when you have two big ones, but PetBar made is easy and it was such a fun experience for me and my dogs! We will be back again!

Brought my dog Olly in for a wash/nail trim and had a great experience! Olly
is a bit of a scared guy and Abby and Tiffany were both very welcoming, patient, and took great care of him!
This place is so clean and the staff is very friendly. They answered all my questions and made my dog feel comfortable. 100% recommended!!

They are awesome! Very easy going and you can tell they love dogs. No need to worry about them treating your dog poorly and best of all they have an amazing service! Would highly recommend this place to anyone looking to go on there own or if there looking for someone to do all the work for them!
Great job! Everyone treats them with love and respect! Love this place
Fantastic service in all ways. Could not be happier
They did an amazing job on my dog. He is a little tough and they worked magic with him. I highly recommend Petbar Arcadia.
I can’t say enough good things about our experience! Tiare was so kind and patient with my nervous pup. He was well taken care of and looks adorable!

Great self wash facility! I’ve been looking for one for a while and am super happy with petbar! They have an easy set up for getting your pup in and out of the wash and blow dry and dryers actually work to fluff. My dog hates water and baths but was happy leaving.
I felt super comfortable leaving my dog in the capable hands of Kat and Dustin. Thanks to the team for making breakfast look so perfect!
First time coming to pet bar and most definitely won’t be the last!! Thank you for making my baby boy look amazing!
Staff was very sweet to our kitten. Very fast service!
Everything was great. Service amazing, they did great job!

It’s a great little place and the employees are wonderful with the animals. I have a very skittish terrier mix that needed  Her nails cut Desperately. They handled her with Care and it was a good experience for her? It would normally be a traumatic experience for her, but she did great.I was very impressed that the groomer did such a great job. I will definitely go back again and would refer anyone

I can’t say enough good things about this grooming experience! Brant, the owner, was fantastic—super easy to work with, friendly, and clearly cares about both the pets and their people. His team did an amazing job bathing and de-shedding my pup, Riggs. He’s a young rescue Shepherd with high anxiety, so grooming can be a challenge, but they handled him with such patience, kindness, and skill. Riggs came home looking great, smelling fresh, and feeling so much more comfortable. I’m beyond impressed with the quality of work and the genuine love they have for animals. Highly recommend Brant and his awesome team!
Patch walked in for a first time nail trim and our experience was great. Baile was awesome.
Very friendly staff and easy to use tubs and dryers. The best do-it-yourself wash and blow-dry (for the doggles of course). Everything you need to keep Spot spotless...
This was my first time coming here. I really liked it very easy to get in and out. I just wish the shampoos were a little bit stronger other than that it was perfect, I’ll definitely be back
The staff was so friendly and welcoming.  Our groomer, Lauren, was fantastic.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND

The owner did not acknowledge the fact that my dog was hurt during grooming. She came limping two times on two separate occasions after grooming. She is the easiest dog to manage and I groom her personally. It was the same groomer both times and he didnt speak english and doesn’t even try to understand you. I was going here for a while but after an email exchange with the owner and lack of ownership to problems that were given I wont return and wont recommend this to anyone. Be careful with your pets here. Sketchy business practices.

I understand the response from the owner. But my dog came back limping again from the same groomer. Hence not coming back to this place. I did not report the issues because It didnt matter. Once is a fluke. Twice is not.
Great facilities, helpful staff, easy to use.
Very dedicated team, great service.

I love the Petbar, so glad I stopped in to check it out. The self wash station is incredibly affordable plus the facility has very nice equipment. I have officially switched over to this place, checks all of the boxes!

Was excited to try the self service, but upon arrival we were turned away. Online it says last drop in accepted was 30 minutes prior to closing. They close at 6, we showed at up 5, there was only one other person using the self service tubs, and 4 other tubs open. The associate then told me the last drop in was at 5, I explained that the website said other wise, but I guess she makes her own set of rules. Sucks because it wasn't convenient for us to make the trip there and I felt like she just didn't want to let us use the tub because it was going to be more work for her by the time we were done. Will not be returning.

Very clean and the staff was very friendly.
Everything was provided for the self serve dog wash. Past my expectations
I took my baby for a hair cut and nail cut I am so happy with petbar that I will be returning with my baby Boss. The cost was not high it fit for the things we had done.  Thank u Petbar

I can’t thank this place enough, this was my puppy’s first time and they were so patient with her since she was so scared. She got a hair cut and her nails trimmed as well, will definitely recommend to all my friends with nervous pups! Nice open area so that they are as comfortable as possible. I love it, thank you Hailey!! From Rosie and her happy momma🥰

Before and after, look how happy she is!!
Very clean facility, helpful staff.
Chica was very well taken care of her white hair was so clean & shiny & her nails were trimmed perfectly, thank you so much.

They were so incredibly welcoming and giving me me knowledge about the care of my dogs breed. they absolutely loved on my precious boy, he was so well taken care of that he pranced, head held high absolutely feeling himself after his appointment.  I have never seen him so comfortable and confident at the groomers !
Love the place :3

If my dog let Cat carry him that tells me, she is amazing. Highly recommended her. she is an animal lover. The spot is super clean.

The woman working there was cleaning up but welcomed me and gladly showed me how to bath my dog. I really appreciated that she let me come in. Grateful for her kindness and help.

Blanche doesn’t love having baths.  We stopped in here and tried the self serve wash and were in and out with a fresh clean dog in no time at all!!  Took our pretty girl to lunch to show her off.  We’ll definitely be using PetBar regularly now!!
We walked in at 5:30. Then was told you guys close at 4:45. Why are you open until 6 then?...
Extremely satisfied! Don’t let Bernie’s frowny eyes fool you.
Friendly, good service
first time taking my pup here and will always come here! The staff are so friendly and they took really good care of my girl. Thank you!
Highly recommend! The staff was super helpful, clean and positive environment! Will definitely be back
My baby came out clean cut and smelling beautiful!! Good Job girls!!
Hailey was Lilli’s groomer today and not only was she a genuinely kind soul,  she did what could only be described as art grooming Lilli!
My first time at Pet Bar! Jasmine was great! Definitely coming back!
My golden got his first full body haircut with Hailey and she did such a great job! He looks and feels amazing! Definitely will be visiting the PetBar again!!
First time @ pet bar & had a great experience. Hailey was amazing! Super sweet & knowledgeable. The staff was very welcoming & treated my puppy like their own.
Fun place to wash your best  friend soap, towels everything you need!
Great grooming!  Cat did a great job on my Stella!
Great service. PROFESSIONAL. HALIE (the groomer) DID A GREAT JOB.

Heather is the absolute best. She's confident, patient and caring. I'll be back regularly thanks to her service. I couldn't be any more pleased with my experience. I have a pitty mix that's hates nail trims and today (her first time) was successful thanks to Heather. -Kelli Grist

I took my very verbal chihuahua to get his nails trimmed and the young lady was so great with him and he  didn’t fuss at all, definitely a customer now
